_about: Public-domain Joseph Angus (1816-1902), Baptist minister and president of Stepney (later Regent's Park) College, for the Word Hoard: The Voluntary System (1839), Christ our Life (1853), The Bible Hand-book (1857 printing) and Apostolic Missions (1871), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

angus-voluntary-system: The voluntary system: a prize essay, in reply to the lectures of Dr. Chalmers on church establishments (London, Jackson and Walford, 1839)
angus-christ-our-life: Christ our life: in its origin, law, and end (Philadelphia, American Baptist publication society, 1853)
angus-bible-handbook: The Bible hand-book : an introduction to the study of Sacred Scripture (Philadelphia : W.S. & A. Martien, 1857)
angus-apostolic-missions: Apostolic missions, the gospel for every creature : a sermon first preached before the Baptist Missionary Society, April 26, 1871 (London : James Nisbet & Co., 1871)

_excluded.angus-other: His editions of Butler's Analogy (Butler's book); his Handbooks of the English Tongue and of English Literature (not divinity); Welsh and Italian translations of the Bible Hand-book

angus-bible-handbook.ia_possible_copyright_status: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item.
